news.headline: Neuraxis swaps 1.3M options for RSUs, adds new executive/director grants
news.summary: NeurAxis disclosed that its previously approved option-for-RSU exchange became effective, converting 1,319,394 options into RSUs for CEO Brian Carrico, CMO Adrian Miranda and CRO Thomas Carrico, and that the Compensation Committee separately granted new multi-year RSU awards to officers and one-time equity awards to independent directors.

news.headline: NRXS Stock Dips Post Q2 Earnings Despite Revenue Surge, Gross Margin Up
news.summary: Shares fell roughly 7% after Q2 results as NeurAxis posted a wider-than-expected per-share loss ($0.19 vs. $0.16 forecast) even though revenue grew 116% and gross margin expanded to 85.9%.

news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year Over Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: NeurAxis reported Q2 2026 revenue of $1.9 million, up 116% year over year, its eighth straight quarter of double-digit growth, crediting the new Category I CPT code for PENFS effective January 2026 for expanding payer coverage.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage for PENFS representing over 500,000 covered lives, extending IB-Stim access for beneficiaries in the Mid-Atlantic region.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis announced it would report Q2 2026 results before market open on August 11, 2026, with a conference call at 9:00 a.m. ET to review results and provide a business update.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 Stock Dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: NeurAxis's board declared its Q2 2026 Series B Preferred Stock dividend payable entirely in common shares (about 80,463 shares) rather than cash, continuing its equity-based capital management approach.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results and business-update call; exact date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: Payer coverage expansion
catalysts.detail: Continued rollout of new medical policies covering PENFS/IB-Stim beyond the >500K covered lives added in the Mid-Atlantic in early August 2026.

catalysts.label: Category I CPT code reimbursement ramp
catalysts.detail: Continued benefit from the AMA Category I CPT code for PENFS (effective January 1, 2026) driving revenue and margin growth through 2026.

catalysts.label: Veterans Affairs FSS contract ramp
catalysts.detail: Early-stage adoption of IB-Stim under the VA Federal Supply Schedule contract (effective December 2025), which management has said is tracking ahead of initial internal expectations but is not yet reflected in analyst models.

catalysts.label: RED device commercialization progress
catalysts.detail: Further commercialization updates on the FDA-cleared Rectal Expulsion Device (RED) for chronic constipation/pelvic floor dysfunction screening.

pulse: NeurAxis continues to post record top-line growth — Q2 2026 revenue rose 116% YoY to $1.9M with gross margin near 86% — driven by expanding payer coverage and the new Category I CPT code for PENFS, but the stock sold off after the August 11 print on a wider-than-expected per-share loss and traded around $6.90s in the following weeks. Since the earnings release, company-specific activity has been limited to routine compensation actions (an option-for-RSU exchange and new executive/director RSU grants disclosed August 19, with related insider Form 4 filings through August 24), with no new business catalysts, filings, or analyst updates reported through August 27. The two analysts covering the stock still carry Buy/Strong Buy ratings with price targets around $11-13, and the near-term story remains unchanged: watch continued payer-coverage wins, VA contract ramp, and CPT-code-driven volume growth into Q3 2026 earnings (expected around November).
